description: Whether a date is a business day on one or more settlement calendars (NYSE, Fedwire/FedACH, TARGET2, UK), which holiday closes it, NYSE early closes, and the previous/next business day. calendars.description: Comma list of calendars; a day is a business day only if open in all. XNYS (NYSE), FED (Fedwire/FedACH), TARGET2 (EUR), UK-ENG. Aliases: NYSE, US, ACH, EUR, UK. Default FED.
